body.html: The main draw of Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem is that it's a spacious, clean hotel right on Phetkasem Road in a spot that's easy to drive in and out of. The hotel has around 47 rooms, sitting on the Phetkasem Road side in Om Noi, Krathum Baen, only about 600 m from the Sakorn Kasem junction. It suits drivers passing through on business around Om Noi and Krathum Baen, people visiting factories in the area, or anyone using it as a base before heading to Don Wai floating market and Sampran (Rose Garden) nearby.

What real reviews praise most is that the rooms are bigger than the price and clean. Many guests note that the rooms feel open and roomy, the beds are comfortable, and housekeeping is good. Rooms come with a fridge, flat-screen TV, tea/coffee maker, air conditioning and an en-suite bathroom; some Premier rooms have a small balcony, and the suite is especially spacious for groups. The decor leans practical and clean rather than luxurious, but overall it's well kept and feels like good value.

On service and convenience, reviews highlight the free covered parking, lift and the in-house Chinese restaurant. There's a 24-hour front desk with security, CCTV, luggage storage, and meeting/function rooms for events. For self-drivers, the free covered parking is a real plus since this area runs mostly on cars. The on-site Chinese restaurant means you don't have to go far if you arrive late.
"The room was very spacious for the price, clean, comfortable bed, free covered parking, easy to drive in and out along Phetkasem Road. Good for a stay around Om Noi and Krathum Baen."

What to keep in mind is that the walls are fairly thin and you can hear the room next door — a point real reviews mention repeatedly, including TV noise, bathroom water sounds and sometimes people talking. Light sleepers should bring earplugs and ask for a room not next to the lift or meeting rooms. Another point: the spa in the name reportedly isn't open yet, as several reviews note — if you're counting on the spa, don't, and check with the hotel before booking.

There are also a couple of smaller things to know: some in-room items come in modest supply, and some staff have limited English. A few reviews mention that soap and shampoo are provided sparingly, there's no iron or pressing service on hand, and bathroom lighting in some rooms is on the dim side. On top of that, breakfast isn't standard in every package, so check when booking whether it's included. The location on a main road also suits people with a car more than those relying on public transport.

Overall, Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem scores around 8.2 out of 10 from over 788 real reviews. It's a spacious-room hotel that suits drivers visiting Om Noi and Krathum Baen, or anyone using it as a Phetkasem Road base before heading into Bangkok or out to Don Wai and Sampran. Rooms start around ฿900 for a Deluxe, rising to roughly ฿1,200–1,800 for a Premier with a balcony or the suite. If you can live with thin walls, no spa and modestly stocked rooms, it's a good-value option in this area.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem Samut Sakhon

faq.q: Where in Samut Sakhon is Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is at 113/2 Moo 11, Phetkasem Road, Om Noi, Krathum Baen, Samut Sakhon. It sits right on Phetkasem Road, about 600 m from the Sakorn Kasem junction. It's around a 15-minute drive to Don Wai floating market and Sampran (Rose Garden), and it suits self-drivers in the Om Noi and Krathum Baen area.

faq.q: How much does Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about ฿900/night for a Deluxe King/Twin. Options range from Deluxe rooms to Premier rooms with a balcony and a Premier Suite King. Premier rooms and the suite rise to roughly ฿1,200–1,800 depending on dates and room type — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem like — are they spacious?
faq.a: Real reviews praise the spacious, clean rooms above all. It's a hotel of around 47 rooms; many guests say the rooms feel open and roomy with comfortable beds, a fridge, flat-screen TV and tea/coffee maker, and some Premier rooms have a balcony. The thing to keep in mind is that the walls are fairly thin and you can hear the room next door.

faq.q: Does Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem have a spa and parking?
faq.a: There's free covered parking and a lift, handy for self-drivers. As for the spa in the name, several reviews say it isn't open yet, so if you're coming for the spa, confirm with the hotel before booking.

faq.q: Who is Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem best for?
faq.a: It's best for drivers visiting Om Noi and Krathum Baen, or anyone wanting a spacious, clean room with parking on Phetkasem Road at a low-thousands price. It suits people with a car and those using it as a base before visiting Don Wai and Sampran — not those after a tourist district or public transport.

faq.q: Does Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem include breakfast?
faq.a: Breakfast isn't included in every package, so check when booking. There is an in-house Chinese restaurant, and the hotel is on Phetkasem Road with restaurants and convenience stores nearby.
